data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Di was a goddess of justice and a judge of the underworld. In Christianity, the name Di may symbolize being a judge of one's own actions and living a righteous life. The name Di carries the meaning “God's judge” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Di usually hope their child will grow to embody god's judge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
